title: Motor overheat
fullDescription:
Miele upright and canister vacuums show F1 when the motor thermal protector trips. Causes include a clogged hose, full bag, or restricted filter.

Let the vacuum cool 30 minutes and clear the airflow path.

fixSteps.title: Clear airflow
fixSteps.instruction: Replace bag and check hose for clogs.

title: Brushroll obstruction
fullDescription:
F2 indicates the powered brushroll motor stalled or drew excessive current. Hair, string, or carpet fringe wrapped around the brush is the typical cause.

Clear with scissors and verify free rotation.

title: Battery fault
shortDescription: Battery pack not communicating or charge fault.
fullDescription:
On cordless Triflex models, F3 indicates the battery pack BMS is reporting a fault or the cells are out of balance.

Charge fully; if F3 persists, the battery pack needs replacement.

title: Charging fault
fullDescription:
F4 is shown when the docking station or charger is not communicating with the battery. Inspect contacts and the AC adapter.

Clean contacts with isopropyl alcohol if dirty.

faq.a: Use only Miele to avoid F4.

title: Dust bin full
fullDescription:
On Blizzard and Triflex models, F5 indicates the dust bin reached its full level. Empty and tap to dislodge fines.

Clean the lifetime filter every six months.

fixSteps.title: Empty bin
fixSteps.instruction: Open bin lid over trash; tap.

title: Filter replacement
fullDescription:
F6 is shown when filter usage exceeds the recommended replacement interval. Aged filters reduce suction and can damage the motor.

Replace with Miele-genuine filter.

title: Bag missing or full
shortDescription: Dust bag not detected or full.
fullDescription:
F7 indicates the bag holder is empty or the bag is full. Insert a genuine Miele bag and confirm the holder is closed correctly.

Generic bags often trip the sensor.

fixSteps.title: Install bag
fixSteps.instruction: Insert genuine Miele bag and close cover.

title: Hose blockage
fullDescription:
F8 is shown when airflow drops below the threshold. Inspect hose, wand, and tools for clogs.

Use a coat hanger to dislodge stuck items.

title: Power cord fault
fullDescription:
F10 on canister vacuums indicates the auto-rewind cord mechanism failed. Pull cord fully out and try again; if persistent, the rewind spring needs service.

Do not force the cord.

fixSteps.title: Untangle
fixSteps.instruction: Pull cord fully out, smooth, retract.

title: Communication fault
fullDescription:
F12 indicates the controls on the handle lost communication with the main body. Reseat the wand and ensure the contacts are clean.

Corroded contacts can be cleaned with isopropyl alcohol.
